email_source: No public email found after deep search: Instagram business_email unreachable (IG API blocked, see instagram_access_note), Fresha listing shows 'not currently affiliated/partnered with Fresha' with no email field, Yellow Pages listing has no email, Facebook page blocked by login wall (mbasic and www both), Yelp blocked (403/captcha). Florida Sunbiz/commerceflorida records show registered agent name (Aura Grullon) but no email.
has_own_site_check: Tested aurysbarbershop.com (no DNS/connection), auryssalon.com (no DNS/connection), aurysunisex.com (no DNS/connection), aurysunisexsalon.com (no DNS/connection). aurysalon.com DOES resolve (HTTP 200) but is a completely unrelated business: 'Aury Salón de belleza' in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico (og:locale es_MX, WhatsApp +52 322 110 4025, unrelated address) -- confirmed NOT the Kissimmee business, purely a name coincidence. Booksy listing (booksy.com/en-us/1087670_aury-s-salon-barber-shop-inc_barber-shop_134766_kissimmee) redirects to 'showBusinessPubliclyUnavailableModal' (delisted/inactive). A second Booksy account tied to this shop, 'Timeless Haircuts' (booked via timelesshaircuts.booksy.com, linked from an Instagram post caption), redirects to 'showBusinessDeletedModal' (deleted). Fresha listing (fresha.com/lvp/aurys-salon-barber-shop-inc-...) explicitly states the business 'is not currently affiliated with or partnered with Fresha' and shows no website field. No external_url could be pulled from the Instagram bio because the official IG web API blocked every attempt (see instagram_access_note). Conclusion: no independently-owned domain exists.
instagram_access_note: instagram.com/api/v1/users/web_profile_info/?username=aurysunisex with header x-ig-app-id: 936619743392459 consistently returned HTTP 400 with body {"message":"Asset asset://laser.provider/ig_business_category_subvertical has been deleted. You cannot use this schema","status":"fail"} across 5+ attempts (direct curl, mobile UA, i.instagram.com host, alternate app-id header combos) plus a retry via the r.jina.ai reader proxy (which returned a different but equally blocking 'useragent mismatch' error) -- confirmed as active anti-bot enforcement on Instagram's side, not an environment/proxy artifact (checked via /__agentproxy/status). Well past the 2-attempt cap in the pipeline, so research fell back to: (1) imginn.com, a third-party read-only Instagram mirror, which DID return the account's public post-grid thumbnails (this is how the 6 gallery photos + profile picture were obtained, all verified real JPEGs via `file`); (2) Birdeye's aggregated Google review feed for reviews/rating; (3) Yellow Pages, Fresha, Booksy, Facebook, Sunbiz/commerceflorida for business data. Individual imginn.com/p/<code>/ detail pages were tested for higher-resolution images but were found to inject unrelated stock/ad content (a PSG soccer team photo and a World Cup graphic) alongside the real post image, so only the vetted profile-grid thumbnails (480px, clearly on-topic, individually eyeballed) were used -- no imginn per-post images were used blindly.
booking_note: Both known Booksy listings for this business (main shop listing and the 'Timeless Haircuts' sub-listing referenced in an Instagram caption) are currently delisted/deleted server-side (Booksy shows 'business publicly/deleted' modals). The Fresha listing is an unclaimed generic stub (categories 'Eyebrow Threading / Threading' and 'Bridal Makeup' only, stock placeholder photos from OTHER businesses, explicit 'not partnered with Fresha' disclaimer). No live online booking channel could be confirmed; phone and walk-in are the real, current channels, consistent with the hours published everywhere.
language_note: Every verbatim review found (Google, via Birdeye and Yellow Pages) is in English. Instagram caption sampled ('Guelo Barber', hashtags like #barberreels/#fades) is English. Fresha's official category labels for this business are English. Kissimmee/Osceola County has a large Latino community and the business likely serves Spanish-speaking clients too, so the site was built fully bilingual (EN default, ES toggle) per pipeline requirement, but English is the verified primary language of the business's own public content.
hours: Monday-Saturday: 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM; Sunday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM
hours_source: Identical across Birdeye (live JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification), Yellow Pages, and Google-search snippet citing the Google Business Profile. Cross-verified 3 independent sources, fully consistent.
rating_source: Birdeye live page (reviews.birdeye.com/aurys-saln-barber-shop-inc-170181537332504), which aggregates this business's Google reviews. Fetched raw HTML on 2026-07-18: embedded JSON-LD reads aggregateRating {ratingValue: 4.6, reviewCount: 160}, matching the businessId/businessNumber used across all 5 individually-parsed review entries on that same live page.
review_count_discrepancy_note: A cached Google-search snippet (search engine's own indexed copy of the Birdeye page title) showed '155 Reviews' in its title tag, while the live fetch of the same Birdeye URL on 2026-07-18 shows 160 in both the on-page JSON-LD and the rendered page text. Resolved by treating the live, freshly-fetched structured data (160) as authoritative over the stale search-index snapshot (155): search engines cache page titles and can lag behind the live page by days/weeks, and Birdeye's aggregateRating count updates continuously as new Google reviews come in, so 160 is simply a few reviews more recent than whatever moment the search engine last crawled/cached the page.

services_source: No live, itemized price menu could be found: both Booksy listings tied to this business are delisted/deleted, and the Fresha listing is an unclaimed stub with only 2 generic category labels and no real photos. In place of a price list, the site shows REAL, independently-corroborated service categories with NO invented prices, sourced from: (a) Fresha's own official category tags for this specific business listing ('Eyebrow Threading', 'Threading', 'Bridal Makeup'), (b) Yellow Pages / Birdeye business categories ('Beauty Salons, Barbers, Hair Stylists, Estheticians'), (c) services explicitly named inside real customer reviews (cut, color, highlights, style/blowout, keratin treatment, wash & set, beard). The site explicitly tells visitors pricing varies and to call, rather than fabricating numbers.
prices_note: No official/current price list found (see services_source). Anecdotal prices appear in old customer reviews (e.g. a disputed $50 charge vs $35 quoted for a wash & set circa 2012, and a disputed $65 haircut/color complaint) but these are one-sided complaint anecdotes, not a published menu, so they were deliberately NOT used as if they were official pricing -- doing so would misrepresent disputed anecdotes as real menu prices. The site's services section states 'Pricing varies by length and style, call and we'll quote you right away' instead.
brand_vibe: Instagram profile picture (real, pulled via imginn.com mirror) shows the actual storefront window: a light tan/beige panel with bold black 'BAR BER SHOP' lettering and several small colorful (pink/yellow) service-price flyers taped to the glass, in a strip-mall unit. Real gallery photos show a fairly standard modern barbershop/salon interior (light walls, mirrors, black barber chairs, ring lights typical of Reels-era barbershops). No single strong brand color scheme is evidenced beyond black-on-tan signage, so the site uses a warm dark charcoal base with an amber/copper-gold accent -- a classic barbershop palette (deliberately shifted off the exact champagne-gold of the Mizu exemplar to avoid a copy-paste palette: --accent-deep #d3a15a / --accent-mid #b98b52 vs Mizu's #eacda4/#c2ab90).

images_note: Downloaded 13 real thumbnails from the business's own Instagram post grid via imginn.com (a third-party read-only IG mirror, used only after Instagram's own API was confirmed blocked, see instagram_access_note) and visually inspected every single one before choosing. Discarded per the visual-curation gate: 2 photos with a burned-in 'CapCut' watermark bar across the frame, 2 heavily motion-blurred/out-of-focus shots, 1 photo that was a 3-image collage with a colorful 'BY NANCY' text caption baked into the pixels, 1 extreme macro close-up too abstract to read as a result shot, and the 150x150 profile picture (kept only as unused reference, see storefront-window.jpg note above). 6 clean, well-lit, finished-result photos remained and are used across hero/about/process-card/gallery (with reuse across sections, consistent with the design system's guidance to pick the best available real photos rather than pad with weak ones). All 6 verified with `file` as valid JPEGs, 27-41KB each, well above the 15KB minimum.
research_note: Research conducted 2026-07-18. Business identity, address, phone and hours cross-verified across 5+ independent sources (Booksy, Fresha, Yellow Pages, Birdeye, Nextdoor, Google-search snippets) with full agreement. Legal ownership verified via Florida Sunbiz corporate records. No own domain confirmed via direct DNS/HTTP testing of 5 domain variants plus inspection of both booking-platform listings. No public email found despite checking every source in the pipeline's deep-email-search checklist. No live price menu found because both of the business's Booksy listings are currently delisted/deleted and its Fresha listing is an unclaimed stub; the services section therefore lists only real, corroborated service categories with no invented prices, and directs visitors to call for a quote.
